description: Evaluation set for Insurance-Policy-RAG (bundled SAMPLE policy). In-scope questions must retrieve, answer, contain all expected_keywords, and cite a chunk on one of expected_pages (any-of; pages verified against app/demo_index). Out-of-scope questions must abstain with the exact idk_answer string; 'hard' ones are insurance-adjacent near-misses. Questions in_09-in_12 and out_05-out_06 were added 2026-10-23 and have not been through a calibration run yet.

in_scope.question: Is physiotherapy covered under paramedical services?
in_scope.notes: Section 3 - Extended health care benefit > Paramedical services

in_scope.question: Which prescription drugs are covered, and which are excluded?
in_scope.notes: Prescription drug benefit (reworded: the annual dollar maximum is not in this policy - it defers to the Schedule of Benefits; ask about formulary/coverage/exclusions instead)

in_scope.question: When is a Prior Authorization form needed?
in_scope.notes: Section 1 - How your policy works > When is a Prior Authorization form needed?

in_scope.question: What expenses are excluded from health care benefits?
Who is eligible for coverage under this policy?
in_scope.notes: Section 1 - How your policy works > Eligibility

in_scope.question: How do I submit a claim?
Are emergency medical travel benefits covered under this policy?
Is dental coverage included, and on which plans?
in_scope.notes: Dental benefit (not available on DrugPlus or HealthStarter plans)

in_scope.question: How long is the grace period for overdue premiums?
Within what time period must a claim have happened for it to be paid?
in_scope.notes: Section 2 - How we pay claims: claims that happened within the last 12 months (added 2026-10-23, uncalibrated)

in_scope.question: What is the maximum for accidental dental under emergency medical travel benefits?
in_scope.notes: Section 4 - Accidental dental, up to $2,000 (added 2026-10-23, uncalibrated)

in_scope.question: What is the conversion privilege when a dependent's coverage ends?
in_scope.notes: Section 6 - Conversion privilege: age 21, contact within 30 days (added 2026-10-23, uncalibrated)

out_of_scope.question: What is the capital of France?
out_of_scope.notes: General knowledge, unrelated to the policy.

out_of_scope.question: Does this policy cover flood damage to my house?
out_of_scope.notes: Property/home insurance, not covered by this health policy.

out_of_scope.question: Will my car insurance premium go up after an accident?
out_of_scope.notes: Auto insurance, not covered by this health policy.

out_of_scope.question: Can you give me legal advice about suing my insurer?
Does this policy cover veterinary bills for my pet?
out_of_scope.notes: Insurance-adjacent near-miss: pet insurance is not in this health policy (added 2026-10-23, uncalibrated).

out_of_scope.question: What interest rate does Manulife charge on a mortgage?
out_of_scope.notes: Names the insurer, which appears on every page, but mortgages are not in this policy (added 2026-10-23, uncalibrated).
